registrationSubtitle: Register your club for an open STAGE Regional League division. Spots are limited - apply early.

checkBackRegistration: Check back when a season is in Registration status.
adminAssignsDivision: New clubs enter the lowest open division. Returning clubs follow their next-season placement.
registrationStep1: Submit your application for a region before registration closes.
registrationStep2: Division placement is automatic: new clubs enter the lowest open division, while returning clubs follow promotion, relegation, or retention rules.
registrationStep3: Admin reviews and assigns you to a division. You'll see your status update here.
registrationStep4: Once approved, your club appears in the league standings automatically.
registrationStep5: Registration closes when the season goes Active. Late applications are not accepted.
placementPreference: You register for the region. The system decides the correct division from club history and open spots.
